meta.name: awq-quantization
meta.description: Activation-aware weight quantization for 4-bit LLM compression with 3x speedup and minimal accuracy loss. Use when deploying large models (7B-70B) on limited GPU memory, when you need faster inference than GPTQ with better accuracy preservation, or for instruction-tuned and multimodal models. MLSys 2024 Best Paper Award winner.

copy.tagline: 用4位量化压缩大模型，推理加速3倍
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在有限显存上部署7B-70B大模型并追求低精度损失
copy.tagline_en: Compress large models with 4-bit quantization, 3x faster inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy 7B-70B models on limited GPU memory with minimal accuracy loss

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以将大型语言模型（7B-70B参数）压缩为4位精度，推理速度提升约2.5-3倍，内存减少2.5-4倍，精度损失小于5%。
howto.when: 当需要部署大模型到有限GPU内存（如A100、RTX 4090）时，或要求比GPTQ更快的推理和更好的精度时触发。

say.text: 用AWQ量化Mistral-7B模型，保存到本地。

say.note: 直接使用已量化的模型进行推理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can compress large language models (7B-70B parameters) to 4-bit precision, achieving ~2.5-3x inference speedup, 2.5-4x memory reduction, and <5% accuracy loss.
howto.when_en: Triggered when deploying large models on limited GPU memory (e.g., A100, RTX 4090), or when faster inference than GPTQ with better accuracy is needed.
